lines: The river has come four streets inland.

beats.goal: Hold the parlor against the drowned.
As Lolo Pido: send the drowned back (parry tutorial).
See what the watch can do, and what it costs.
See where the water went.
Night shift at the family's funeral parlor. Decide whether to keep pretending.
Meet the debt at the door.

beats.title: THE WAKE
beats.goal: Work the wake: learn how Mang Berto died.
beats.prompt: Who do you sit with? (Talk to at least two people before midnight.)

options.label: Straighten the flowers by the coffin
Mang Domeng, by the coffee urn

beats.goal: Talk to the dead man at his own wake.
Lola gives you the watch.
Mang Berto forgets himself.
Cut the hunger out of Mang Berto (parry, and learn to dodge).
Send Mang Berto home.
Lola answers one question.
Point the watch at Lola.
Tell Lola, and choose how to leave her.
Follow the water to where it starts.

beats.title: THE ESTERO, 2:16 AM
beats.goal: Ask around, fast: who else is awake at the creek?
beats.prompt: No time to hear everyone. Talk to at least one.

beats.goal: The creek's unsent rise for the watch.
Hold off the creek's unsent dead without a sundang.
Find the Salonga sundô, and decide whether to send him.
The tagged aswang drops.
Survive the aswang. The watch awakens.
See what the watch took from you.
Brace for the gate, and choose: Lola or the van.
Learn who Kardo is.
Get home.
Steady your hands in Kardo's morgue.
Hear what the water did downriver.
Hear Lola's tape.
Answer Hiraya's offer.
The Hiraya hound breaks in.
Fight beside Kardo: he wires it, you cut it.
Decide what to do with the soul in the glass.
Face the morning, and Kapitan Obet.
Find the photograph.
Point the watch at yourself.

recap.text: 1998. Lolo Pido turned a flood back for four minutes and seventeen seconds. Downriver, the water drowned thirty-one people.
At Mang Berto's wake, you nodded at a dead man. He nodded back.
At Mang Berto's wake, you pretended not to see a dead man. He saw you anyway.
You promised Kapitan Obet the money by Friday.
You threw Kapitan Obet out of a wake.
Kapitan Obet came to collect. You poured his coffee and said nothing.
Mang Berto's last fare wore a Hiraya Energy jacket.
You promised Mang Berto you'd tell his wife about the money in the cushion.
You told Mang Berto it wasn't your job.
Lola Ising gave you Lolo Pido's watch. It ticked for you.
Lola Ising gave you Lolo Pido's watch. You dropped it, and the crystal cracked. It ticked for you anyway.
You sent Mang Berto home on Magwayen's boat.
Lola told you what the watch is: it borrows time, and writes every second against the family.
Lola told you why she was leaving: to lead the people hunting the watch away from you.
Lola told you Lolo's four minutes cost him ten years.
You pointed the watch at Lola. It showed 2:40. Tonight.
You laid a salt line across the door, and went to the water.
You left the door open so you'd hear her call, and went to the water.
Aling Tess's son went into the estero three weeks ago. Hiraya never gave her a body.
Kapitan Obet signed the permit for Hiraya's pump on the estero.
A white van comes for Hiraya's tanks every night at two.
You sent home Mang Ambo Salonga, a sundô borrowed down to nothing.
You took Mang Ambo Salonga's ledger. Its last line: DIMACULANGAN. BEING COLLECTED.
The aswang killed you. The watch turned it back, and left a white streak in your hair.
You kept the aswang's Hiraya tag.
Kardo rammed the gate. You chose Lola over the van, and got home one minute late.
Kardo rammed the gate. You chased the van, and saw a woman with a white streak like yours.
Hiraya took Lola Ising. Where her time was, the dial is blank.
Kardo told you the truth: the water Lolo pushed away drowned a boy's father. The boy was Gregorio Villacorta.
Lola's tape: the bus to Vigan was a decoy, meant to lead them away from you.
Hiraya offered Lola, the house and the debt for the watch. You refused.
Hiraya offered Lola, the house and the debt for the watch. You asked for proof.
Hiraya offered Lola, the house and the debt for the watch. You said yes.
Inside the Hiraya hound, a soul in a bottle. You set it free.
Inside the Hiraya hound, a soul in a bottle. You kept it as proof.
Kapitan Obet admitted he sold Lola's debt to Hiraya.
